_comment: Frozen phenotype definitions for the OSF pre-registration osf.io/s6w9c (Part 3). Column names are from Bressan et al. 2023 Table S3 (mmc4.xlsx, header row 2); values there are percentages and are divided by 100.

table_s3._progenitor_rationale: The progenitor set is every Table S3 cluster named as a progenitor or neuroepithelial precursor. Ependymal-like cells are a differentiated non-neuronal type, and the two dopaminergic clusters are neurons.
